name: k8s-cluster-review
description: Use when nothing is broken but someone wants to know whether a Kubernetes cluster, or one namespace, is still in good shape: "review the cluster", "check it against best practices", "what drifted since we deployed it?", after taking over a cluster, or before a busy period. Reviews the live objects, not manifests in a repository, in three groups. Reliability: workloads with one replica, no readiness probe or no requests, PodDisruptionBudgets that allow 0 disruptions or match no pod, all replicas on one node or zone. Security: privileged or root containers, hostPath and hostNetwork, namespaces without Pod Security labels, cluster-admin bound to users or ServiceAccounts, namespaces without NetworkPolicies, :latest images. Hygiene and cost: PVCs no pod mounts, Released PVs, Services without endpoints, LoadBalancers, workloads at 0 replicas, failed Jobs, stale CronJobs. Reports each finding once per workload, with why it matters and when it is fine. Read-only: never changes anything itself.
